title: Extract provider HTTP base URL, error parsing, and request helper boundaries
description: Introduce shared provider HTTP helper modules only where repeated behavior is already visible across concrete chat, voice, embedding, and rerank providers.

files.change: Move repeated API-base normalization, bearer/header assembly, JSON error extraction, and small request helper routines into focused modules.
Use shared helpers only where behavior is already duplicated; keep provider-specific payload mapping local to each adapter.

criteria: Provider-specific request/response mapping stays inside concrete provider modules.
Shared helpers do not erase AstrBot provider capability/family boundaries.
Existing provider tests remain the authority for payload, error, and auth behavior.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-provider && cargo clippy -p astrbot-provider -- -D warnings
